mainEntity.name: Who Are the Exam Preparation Specialists™?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our team of Exam Preparation Specialists™. Free instant marking uses AI, built on our Thinking Hack™ frameworks. Detailed reports are marked by Exam Preparation Specialists™ and ready within 48 hours.

Free instant marking costs nothing: 3 free instant markings, no sign-up. Share with 7 people. Get a free detailed report. Detailed feedback is S$39 for 4 reports, as a Monthly Plan by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay (renews monthly, cancel any time) or a 31-Day Pass by PayNow, GrabPay, card or Google Pay (one-off, no renewal).

mainEntity.name: Which Exams and Papers Can EssayLabsg™ Mark?

acceptedAnswer.text: 13 papers: PSLE English, O-Level English, Literature, Social Studies, History and Geography, A-Level General Paper (Paper 1 and the Paper 2 AQ), IB English Lang & Lit and IGCSE English. Free marking covers PSLE English, O-Level English and A-Level GP.

Every essay is marked against its paper's published SEAB, Cambridge or IB criteria, criterion by criterion. The score is an estimate for that one paper, to guide revision. It isn't a prediction of your overall exam grade, and your school's or examiner's mark may differ. EssayLabsg™ is not affiliated with or endorsed by SEAB, Cambridge Assessment or the IB.

mainEntity.name: Who Are the Exam Preparation Specialists™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The team behind EssayLabsg™ and Thinking Hack™. They design the marking criteria and the frameworks EssayLabsg™ uses, and they teach our Masterclasses and classes. Free instant results are marked by AI; detailed reports are marked by Exam Preparation Specialists™.

mainEntity.name: Can I Upload a Handwritten Essay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Snap one clear photo of one page, taken flat in good light, and EssayLabsg™ reads and marks it.

mainEntity.name: How Fast Will I Get My Results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Free instant marking takes about a minute. Detailed feedback is marked by Exam Preparation Specialists™ and ready within 48 hours.

Free instant marking is done by AI against the official criteria, using the frameworks our Exam Preparation Specialists™ teach. Detailed reports are marked by Exam Preparation Specialists™ and ready within 48 hours.
Free marking: your essay is marked and not kept on our servers. Detailed reports, challenge entries and messages are kept as set out in our Privacy Policy.
